method.anchoring: All 40 original expenses stay in the base. Add revenue and cost deltas. Remove 8573 penalties and 6120.75 other income favorable to baseline from forecasts. Known base is unclosed; no final net-profit guarantee.
method.physical_costs: Same dish counts and physical rolls per all-business order. Additional packaging scales with orders. 50% of consumables and existing electricity/water scale with orders; 50% fixed. Losses scale with food budget, no quality savings credited. Replace these unmeasured drivers.
method.couriers: Scale the full historical courier budget with delivered order count at constant delivery share, including proportional growth in guarantees. This is a conservative budget assumption, NOT the per-delivery tariff and NOT a customer delivery charge.
method.fees: Baseline expenses retained. Incremental Starter 3% only its revenue share, Yandex 25% only its share. Acquiring, partner and refunds proportional revenue. Same channel mix. No second subtraction of discounts or gift cost.
method.payroll: Full actual base retained. Recompute only change in the single daily theoretical pool from all-revenue tiers and normalized August daily shape. Actual floor residual stays in base. No fund on revenue percentage and no second pool per added worker. Other extra labor/taxes/meals/fund are provisional all-in budgets, not payroll calculations.
method.tax: 6% incremental business tax using confirmed baseline regime. Baseline fixed IP contribution and payroll taxes retained; VAT and loan interest zero per owner for August. Future regime not independently certified. IP additional contribution and deductions, and Yandex settlement completeness remain baseline reconciliation gaps.
method.equipment: 10000 RUB monthly combined allowance for new equipment depreciation, energy, service and consumables. It is not a quote or capex estimate. Existing equipment depreciation remains in base. No payroll saving, retention uplift or loss reduction credited.
method.capacity: Only shared manual forming and dispatch resources, working timing profile. Arrival-hour September shape applied to August rolls/order; 1.3 busy-day stress is a hypothesis, not measured percentile. Machine concurrency, rice, fryer, salamander, pizza, packing/admin/couriers and physical workspace unverified. Extra helpers assumed effective at peak; no guaranteed linear production scalability.
method.price_scope: FC is food budget / revenue AFTER all discounts. Scenario A and B FC apply to total business basket. C is a revenue-weighted mix of 30% new-line baskets and 70% current baskets, so 35% line FC is not 35% whole business. New-line share includes any cannibalization; order totals are required thresholds, not forecasts.
method.rounding: Required orders rounded upward to 50 and tested against later tier drops through 8000 orders. Precision is illustrative, not a safety buffer. Month has 31 days. Twelve zero-revenue orders remain in the base population.
